# The configuration file (`apg.yaml`)

One format describes a gateway's configuration everywhere: a standalone node reads it from a file, and `apgctl apply` sends the same document to a control plane. This page lists every key.

## Top level

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` (required) | `1` |  |  |
| `workspace` | string | `default` | The workspace this document targets. Default: default. |
| `settings` | object |  | Global routing configuration that is not a resource. Each property is one Setting. |
| `flags` | object |  |  |

Each entry of `workspaces` holds a workspace's `name` and the same resource sections. `${VAR}` and `${VAR:-default}` are replaced from the environment before the file is parsed; an unset variable with no default is an error.

## Domain

Under `domains`. A hostname owned by exactly one workspace, with a TLS policy.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `hostname` (required) | string |  | Exact host or single-label wildcard (*.example.com). Lower case. |
| `tls` | object |  |  |
| `tls.mode` | `acme`, `manual`, `none` | `acme` |  |
| `tls.challenge` | `http01`, `dns01` | `http01` |  |
| `tls.certificate` | string |  | Certificate name or id. Required when mode is manual. |
| `labels` | object |  |  |
| `metadata` | object |  | Free-form. Never interpreted by the gateway. At most 16 KiB serialised. |

## Certificate

Under `certificates`. A TLS certificate and its private key. The key is write-only.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` (required) | string |  |  |
| `cert_pem` | string |  | Leaf certificate followed by its chain. |
| `key_pem` | string |  | Write-only. Stored encrypted. Never returned. |
| `cert_file` | string |  | File mode only: path the node reads the certificate from. |
| `key_file` | string |  | File mode only: path the node reads the key from. |
| `labels` | object |  |  |
| `metadata` | object |  | Free-form. Never interpreted by the gateway. At most 16 KiB serialised. |

## CA certificate

Under `ca_certificates`. A PEM bundle used to verify upstreams or client certificates.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` (required) | string |  |  |
| `cert_pem` | string |  |  |
| `cert_file` | string |  | File mode only. |
| `labels` | object |  |  |
| `metadata` | object |  | Free-form. Never interpreted by the gateway. At most 16 KiB serialised. |

## Service

Under `services`. A named upstream: backends plus load-balancing, health, timeout and retry policy.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` (required) | string |  |  |
| `scheme` | `http`, `https` | `http` |  |
| `http_version` | `1.1`, `2` | `1.1` |  |
| `shared` | boolean | `false` | System workspace only: routes in any workspace may reference this service. |
| `backends[]` (required) | list of objects |  |  |
| `backends[].id` | string |  |  |
| `backends[].target` (required) | string |  | host:port, where host is an IP address or DNS name, as a node reaches it. For a node that runs in a container, localhost and 127.0.0.1 are that container, not the machine it runs on. |
| `backends[].weight` | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 1000) | `1` |  |
| `backends[].status` | `active`, `draining`, `down` | `active` |  |
| `backends[].labels` | object |  |  |
| `load_balancing` | object |  |  |
| `load_balancing.strategy` | `round_robin`, `least_connections`, `random`, `hash` | `round_robin` |  |
| `load_balancing.hash_key` | string | `client_ip` | What to key a hash, a limit or a split on. |
| `timeouts` | object |  |  |
| `timeouts.connect_ms` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 600000) | `5000` |  |
| `timeouts.read_ms` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 3600000) | `60000` |  |
| `timeouts.write_ms` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 3600000) | `60000` |  |
| `retries` | object |  |  |
| `retries.attempts` | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 10) | `1` |  |
| `retries.on` | list of object or integer | `["connect_failure"]` |  |
| `retries.non_idempotent` | boolean | `false` |  |
| `retries.buffer_bytes` | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 10485760) | `65536` |  |
| `health_check` | object |  |  |
| `health_check.active` | object |  |  |
| `health_check.active.enabled` | boolean | `true` |  |
| `health_check.active.type` | `http`, `tcp` | `http` |  |
| `health_check.active.path` | string | `/healthz` |  |
| `health_check.active.interval_ms` | integer (≥ 500, ≤ 3600000) | `5000` |  |
| `health_check.active.timeout_ms` | integer (≥ 100, ≤ 60000) | `2000` |  |
| `health_check.active.healthy_threshold` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 20) | `2` |  |
| `health_check.active.unhealthy_threshold` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 20) | `3` |  |
| `health_check.active.expected_statuses` | list of lists of integer (≥ 100, ≤ 599) | `[[200,399]]` | Inclusive ranges, e.g. [[200, 399]]. |
| `health_check.active.host_header` | string |  |  |
| `health_check.passive` | object |  |  |
| `health_check.passive.enabled` | boolean | `true` |  |
| `health_check.passive.consecutive_failures` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 100) | `3` |  |
| `health_check.passive.open_ms` | integer (≥ 100, ≤ 3600000) | `30000` |  |
| `health_check.passive.statuses` | list of integer (≥ 500, ≤ 599) | `[502,503,504]` |  |
| `tls` | object |  |  |
| `tls.verify` | boolean | `true` |  |
| `tls.sni` | string |  |  |
| `tls.ca_certificates` | list of object |  |  |
| `tls.client_certificate` | string |  | A reference to another resource in the same workspace, by name or id. |
| `keepalive` | object |  |  |
| `keepalive.idle_ms` | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 3600000) | `60000` |  |
| `keepalive.max_idle_per_backend` | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 10000) | `64` |  |
| `egress_restricted` | boolean | `false` | When true the node refuses to connect this service to loopback, link-local and private addresses unless APG_BACKEND_ALLOW_CIDRS covers them. The admin sets it from the role of whoever wrote the service; a value sent to the Admin API is ignored. |
| `host_header` | string | `preserve` | preserve, backend, or a literal Host value. |
| `drain_timeout_ms` | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 3600000) | `30000` |  |
| `plugins[]` | list of objects |  | Declarative config only: plugin instances attached to this service. |
| `labels` | object |  |  |
| `metadata` | object |  | Free-form. Never interpreted by the gateway. At most 16 KiB serialised. |

**Not available yet:** `drain_timeout_ms`, `keepalive.max_idle_per_backend`, `retries.buffer_bytes`. Setting one of them to anything but the default is refused, in a file and through the Admin API alike, so nothing is accepted and then ignored.

| `query[]` | list of objects |  |  |
| `query[].name` (required) | string |  |  |
| `query[].type` | `exact`, `regex`, `present` | `exact` |  |
| `query[].value` | string |  |  |
| `priority` | integer (≥ -1000000, ≤ 1000000) | `0` |  |
| `strip_path` | boolean | `false` |  |
| `rewrite` | object |  |  |
| `timeout_ms` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 86400000) |  |  |
| `idle_timeout_ms` | integer (≥ 1000, ≤ 86400000) | `300000` |  |
| `error_responses` | object |  | Custom gateway error responses, keyed by error code. |
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` |  |
| `plugins[]` | list of objects |  | Declarative config only: plugin instances attached to this route. |

| `metadata` | object |  | Free-form. Never interpreted by the gateway. At most 16 KiB serialised. |

## Plugin

Under `plugins`. A plugin instance attached at a scope. `config` is validated separately against schemas/plugins/<type>.json.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `type` (required) | `ip_restriction`, `cors`, `request_size_limit`, `mtls_auth`, `jwt_auth`, `key_auth`, `basic_auth`, `forward_auth`, `acl`, `rate_limit`, `quota`, `bandwidth_limit`, `http_callout`, `wasm`, `redirect`, `static_response`, `request_transformer`, `response_cache`, `response_transformer`, `compression`, `access_log` |  |  |
| `scope` (required) | `global`, `workspace`, `service`, `route` |  |  |
| `scope_ref` | string |  | Service or route name or id. Required for those scopes. |
| `consumer` | string |  | A reference to another resource in the same workspace, by name or id. |
| `target_workspace` | string |  | System routes and services only. |
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` |  |
| `priority` | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 10000) |  |  |
| `config` | object | `{}` |  |
| `labels` | object |  |  |
| `metadata` | object |  | Free-form. Never interpreted by the gateway. At most 16 KiB serialised. |

## Settings

Under `settings`. Global routing configuration that is not a resource. Each property is one Setting.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_base_domains[]` | list of objects |  | Every workspace implicitly owns {slug}.{domain} for each entry. |
| `workspace_base_domains[].domain` (required) | string |  | An exact host; no wildcard. |
| `workspace_base_domains[].tls` | object |  |  |
| `workspace_base_domains[].tls.mode` | `acme`, `manual`, `none` | `acme` |  |
| `workspace_base_domains[].tls.certificate` | string |  | A reference to another resource in the same workspace, by name or id. |
| `workspace_resolvers` | list of string | `["host","consumer"]` | How a request matched by a system route is attributed to a workspace. |
| `workspace_plugin_types` | list of object |  | Plugin types a non-admin role may create. Default: every type except wasm. |
| `error_responses` | object |  | Custom gateway error responses, keyed by error code. |
| `identity_headers` | boolean | `true` |  |
| `access_log` | object |  |  |
| `access_log.sink` | string | `stdout` |  |
| `access_log.sample_rate` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `1` |  |
| `access_log.custom_fields` | object |  |  |

**Not available yet:** `workspace_resolvers`. Setting it to anything but the default is refused, in a file and through the Admin API alike, so nothing is accepted and then ignored.

## Secrets

A secret-typed value is never written as a bare string. It is one of:

| Form | Meaning | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `{ $env: APG_SECRET_NAME }` | Read from the node's environment. The name must start with `APG_SECRET_`. | Files |
| `{ $file: /path }` | Read from a file on the node. | Files |
| `{ $secret: "value" }` | Encrypted by the control plane and sent to nodes as ciphertext. | Admin API, `apgctl` |
| `{ $secret: "***" }` | Keep the value that is stored. This is what `apgctl dump` writes. | `apgctl sync` |
